terra.problem: Saying Shallum's family inherited the job adds a transfer the text does not state. It says their fathers had been assigned to guard the entrance.
Calling Samuel a prophet adds a fact from outside the passage without a reference.
Saying nobody could get past unnoticed goes beyond the text. It says gatekeepers were stationed on all four sides, not that no one could evade them.
Saying the relatives went back to their villages after a week adds what happened afterward. The passage does not say that.
The claim that forty days occurs often in the Bible draws on material outside this passage but gives no supporting references.
The joke says the baker is crying, attributing a reaction to someone Papa Dorin has not been told anything about.
